input.title: [Aikido] Fix security issue in requests via minor version upgrade from 2.33.0 to 2.34.0
input.bodyText:
Upgrade requests to fix proxy bypass vulnerability allowing attackers to skip proxy-based egress controls and SSRF protections via domain boundary matching.
✅ There are no breaking changes
 
 ✅ 1 CVE resolved by this upgrade 
 

This PR will resolve the following CVEs:
| Issue | Severity           | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  AIKIDO-2026-106840  |  MEDIUM  | [requests] Proxy bypass vulnerability in `no_proxy` matching logic allows attackers to bypass proxy-based egress controls by using lookalike domain names that match suffix patterns without respecting domain boundaries. This enables direct connections that circumvent SSRF protections and proxy-based security controls. |
